name: Computer Aided Design
description: This course will enable students to create, render/represent, and assemble a three-dimensional model in fusion 360. The student will be introduced to fundamental aspects of plastic detailing. They also will be introduced to a few open-source AI tools, for example, but not limited to Vizcom, to arrive at some three-dimensional forms that they can create based on their packaging requirements. The student will also be introduced to basic generative modelling in fusion 360. The tool will be introduced practically in the class, and the students will work within the class hours to finish assignments for each module during class hours. The principles discussed in the class would enable students to model any complicated free form shapes irrespective of the tool used. The three-dimensional forms modeled in this class will be designerly, like hair dryers, automotive speed forms, etc., and not engineering forms like gear brackets, shafts, etc.
